items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Dick Campbell called me and asked me to take the first USO show... Dick Campbell was the one... getting most of the artists together for the USO shows.

ctx.x: Yes, that's right. I was right here in New York, but I was getting ready to go back to Europe. So in the meantime Dick Campbell called me and asked me to take the first USO show.
